$comment: Published forms of the API stub (GET /public/v1/forms/{slug}, the PublicFormDto of openapi.public.json) and of the unit tests, with the site lists of GET /public/v1/forms/{slug}/frame-sites. "spike-abstract" is the small form of the 0.1.0 spike written in the definition schema of confera_be, so that the browser tests of the embed, the moment after Send and the probes keep proving the same things on the real renderer; "spike-unlisted" is the same form with an empty site list. "itema-2026-abstract" is the seeded abstract form of confera_be (seededAbstractDefinition of contracts/form-rule-vectors.json) with a deadline; "itema-2026-closed" is that form after its deadline. Written by a script from the vendored contract; invented people only, on example.test.
